messages.content:
How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

message.reasoning: We need to produce a RESTful API request. The user wants to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard. They provide version, IP, API name, and parameters. We need to output the request. According to the instructions, we should not mention the tool usage. We should just output the request. The request format: GET https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=Ethernet&infoType=Speed. Also note that interfaceType expects one of "gigabitethernet", "fastethernet", "ethernet", "serial". They gave "Ethernet" but the allowed values are lowercase? The spec says interfaceType?: "gigabitethernet" | "fastethernet" | "ethernet" | "serial". So we should use "ethernet". Also infoType: "Speed" but allowed values are "statistics" | "status" | "config" | "Speed". "Speed" is allowed. But maybe case-sensitive? It lists "Speed" with capital S. So we keep "Speed". So final request: GET https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed. That is the answer.
